summary: Kustom Entertainment filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its video-solutions division to Cycurion, Inc. Consideration comprises $1.25M cash, a $4.25M secured promissory note, up to $1M earnout, and warrants for 2M shares of Buyer's common stock at $2.80 per share. The deal is expected to close July 15, 2026. Closing conditions include due diligence, carve-out financials, and board approvals. No premium, price per share, or break fee stated. Watch for regulatory clearance and diligence outcomes.
